title: H5: Five stores never roll back failed mutations on the shared viewContext

description: Tag/SmartFilter/Journal/Attachment/Series/Preferences stores - a later, unrelated save() from any store commits the half-built rows; meanwhile TaskStore's own rollback is unconditional and can discard other stores' legitimately staged work sharing the same context. Severity: High. Wave/Plan: Wave 5, plan 5a mutation-scope-discipline. Sweep: stores/persistence. Class-killer: shared withMutationRollback helper adopted by the five bare stores + a conformance test over public mutating methods (full MutationContext re-architecture REJECTED - logged as deliberate tech debt; redesign trigger: cross-contamination despite the conformance test).
